summary: P0: generic yearly wording cannot safely be normalized as benefit_year because Canadian products distinguish calendar, anniversary, plan-defined, first-claim, rolling, per-claim/per-incident, and lifetime periods.
P0: maximum_amount must distinguish eligible-expense maxima from insurer-payment maxima.
P0: R&C is often a dynamic insurer/jurisdiction/service-duration rule and must not be synthesized from the smallest dollar value in a mixed text block.
P0: combined maxima are detected only in notes but not encoded into shared_pool fields, allowing possible overstatement across categories.
P0: deductible_remaining=0 and benefit_used_to_date=0 are unsafe defaults when member state is unknown.
P1: practitioner type/credential and coordination-of-benefits require explicit modeling layers.
requested_review: Reviewer/Primary should evaluate P0 schema hardening before broader parser expansion or booking automation.
